content: {"phoneNote":"The phone header stacks logo, phone number and directions link in three rows, pushing the hero photo below the fold and the '6.30' badge gets cut by the fixed bar at the first screen edge.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero works well with the arched bread photo and hours badge, but the 'Kako pečemo' section leaves a large dead band to the right and below the kneading photo.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Collapse the phone header to logo + menu only; the phone and directions already live in the fixed bar, so the hero photo can rise into the first screen.","Balance the 'Kako pečemo' section on desktop: shorten the photo or add content (e.g. the daily hours or a second photo) so the right column doesn't float in empty dark space.","Fix the price list on phone so product names don't wrap mid-word ('Polnozrnat e žemlje'); allow full-word wrapping or shrink the dotted leader."],"blockers":["Phone price list: 'Polnozrnate žemlje' is broken mid-word into 'Polnozrnat' / 'e žemlje'.","Phone hero: the '6.30' hours badge is clipped by the fixed call bar on the first screen."]}
